findings.evidence: The proof uses only `Subgroup.center`, `Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mem_center_iff`, integer arithmetic, sets, and finite cardinality; `ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup.lean` already develops the center of `SL(2, ℤ)` at `sl2zToPSL2R_ker` and is imported earlier by `PSLAction.lean`.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup.lean` near `sl2zToPSL2R_ker` (or the SpecialLinearGroup directory) under an algebraic namespace, and update the module documentation.
findings.issue: `card_center_specialLinearGroup_two_int` has no upper-half-plane or action dependency, yet its placement gives it the misleading `UpperHalfPlane` namespace and makes broadly useful algebra depend on an analysis module.

summary: The stabilizer lemmas fit the action module, but the center-cardinality theorem is pure matrix-group algebra and is misplaced under `UpperHalfPlane`.
